createicecream.configuration.title: Create IceCream
createicecream.configuration.enabled.too: Master switch. Off = the mod does nothing at all.
createicecream.configuration.preset.tool: QUALITY / BALANCED / PERFORMANCE set animation rates and detail, shadow and sound distances for you. CUSTOM uses your values from the sections below.
createicecream.configuration.hud.tooltip: The panel toggled with F7 (change the key in Controls).
createicecream.configuration.hud.title: Statistics panel
createicecream.configuration.occlusion.t: Machines and trains hidden behind blocks are not drawn (checked on a background thread).
createicecream.configuration.occlusion.e: Background visibility check for Create machines and trains.
AUTO = on, unless Entity Culling is installed (it already does this).
createicecream.configuration.gateVisualU: Without shaders: hidden machines stop updating their animation.
createicecream.configuration.maxDistance: Only machines closer than this are checked.
Extra margin around each machine. More = fewer pop-ins, less hiding.
createicecream.configuration.visibleHold: A machine stays drawn this long after it was last seen.
createicecream.configuration.threadSleep: Pause of the background thread between checks.
createicecream.configuration.leavesAreOp: Treat leaves as solid for hiding (faster, can hide things seen through leaves).
createicecream.configuration.trustedRend: Machines drawn outside their block whose box is still accurate.
createicecream.configuration.berFrustumC: Sodium draws some Create machines even behind you; this skips them.
createicecream.configuration.contraption: Trains and contraptions in tunnels or behind hills are not drawn (shadows stay).
createicecream.configuration.blacklist.t: Block entity types that are never hidden.
createicecream.configuration.animation.t: Far machines and trains animate at a lower rate. Trains still move smoothly.
createicecream.configuration.animation.e: Lower animation rate for far machines and trains.
createicecream.configuration.fullRateDis: Closer than this, everything animates every frame. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.midDistance: Beyond this, the far rate is used. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.midFps.tool: Animation rate between the two distances. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.farFps.tool: Animation rate far away. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.throttleBlo: With shaders: far machines are redrawn less often.
createicecream.configuration.throttleCon: Far trains and contraptions are redrawn less often; movement stays smooth.
createicecream.configuration.frustumGati: Without shaders: machines outside the view stop updating.
createicecream.configuration.frustumPadd: Extra margin around machines for the view check.
createicecream.configuration.managedPack: Advanced: which mods' animations are managed.
createicecream.configuration.noFrustumGa: Advanced: visuals that are never paused outside the view.
createicecream.configuration.shadows.too: Settings for the shadow pass of shader packs.
createicecream.configuration.shadowDista: Machines and trains farther than this cast no shadow. 0 = all. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.animationFp: Animation rate inside shadows at any distance. 0 = off. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.finiteTrack: Curved tracks outside the view are skipped (Create gives them an infinite box).
createicecream.configuration.fastRendere: Turn off only to check whether a visual glitch comes from this mod.
createicecream.configuration.shadowFaceC: Faster, but trains can lose their shadow with some shader packs.
createicecream.configuration.contraption: Models that don't change are recorded once and then copied.
Whole curves are recorded once and copied.
createicecream.configuration.lightRefres: How often cached contraptions pick up light changes.
createicecream.configuration.workerThrea: -1 = automatic, 0 = off. Builds Create models on other CPU cores.
createicecream.configuration.movingLight: A moving train re-reads its lighting every N blocks.
createicecream.configuration.lod.tooltip: Small extras of far machines are skipped.
createicecream.configuration.lod.title: Distant details
createicecream.configuration.lod.enabled: Skip items on belts/depots and text on boards far away.
createicecream.configuration.detailDista: Beyond this, details are skipped. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.shadowDetai: Same for shader shadows. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.limiter.too: Skip inaudible and duplicate one-shot sounds (steam engines).
createicecream.configuration.cullDistanc: Farther one-shot sounds are not started. (Presets override this.)
createicecream.configuration.maxSamePerT: At most this many copies of one sound start per tick.
createicecream.configuration.misc.title: Misc
createicecream.configuration.debugOverla: One status line on the F3 screen.
createicecream.hud.note.disabled: The mod is disabled in its settings.
createicecream.hud.note.noSodium: Sodium is not installed: fast renderer, caches and threads are off.
createicecream.hud.note.fastRendererOff: Fast renderer is turned off in the settings.
createicecream.hud.note.threadsFellBack: Worker threads turned themselves off (see log).
createicecream.hud.note.flywheel: No shaders: Flywheel draws Create on the GPU, most features idle (normal).
